```{r}
plot_top_genes <- function(data, dge_results_all, title) {
  for (n in sort(unique(dge_results_all$cluster))) {
    tmp = subset(dge_results_all, cluster==n)
    if(nrow(tmp)<1) next
    tmp_up = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC > 0)
    if(nrow(tmp_up)<1) next
    tmp_up$direction = "up"
    #tmp_down = subset(tmp, avg_log2FC < 0)
    #tmp_down$direction = "down"
    
    #final_top_genes = rbind(head(tmp_up,10), head(tmp_down,10))
    final_top_genes = head(tmp_up, 10)
    final_top_genes = final_top_genes[order(final_top_genes$avg_log2FC),]
    final_top_genes$gene = factor(final_top_genes$gene, levels = final_top_genes$gene)
    p = ggplot(final_top_genes, aes(y=avg_log2FC, x=gene, fill=direction)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, ", ", title)) + coord_flip() + theme(axis.text.y =  element_text(size=12) )
    print(p)
    
  }
}
```

```{r}

plot_genes <- function(dataset, genes, split.by=NULL) {
  
  all_genes =rownames(dataset@assays$RNA)
  
  for (g in genes) {
    if (!g %in% all_genes) {
      print(paste0("Gene ",g," has no data (possibly filtered out)."))
      next
    } else {
        p1  =FeaturePlot(object = dataset, features = g, reduction="umap", split.by=split.by, label=T)
        p2 = VlnPlot(dataset, features = g, ncol = 1, pt.size = 0.01, split.by = split.by)
        if (is.null(split.by)) {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=2,align="h"))
        } else {
          print(plot_grid(p1,p2, ncol=1,align="v"))
        }
        
    }
  }
}
```


# Marker exploration 

## Selection markers and markers of epithelial and contaminating cells

These are markers used in the cell sorting to select cells for scRNA analysis. Cells were sorted as Lgr5+ eGFP cells from Lgr5-EGFP-IRES-CreER(T2) mice. Since eGFP will be expresed in the offspring of cells positive for Lgr5 at the time of Cre induction, we would expect mainly epithelial cells to be selected. 

We here also include markers that should be negative (Cd45 (Ptprc), Cd34, Vim, Myh11) but might be positive in contaminating cells.



```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("LGR5","AXIN2","EPCAM","PTPRC","CD34","VIM", "MYH11")
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
```



## Epithelial subgroup markers

Cd44, Sox2, Lgr5 - Lgr5+ signature
Muc6 - gland base cells
Gast, Ghrl, Chga - G-cells
Dclk1 - Tuft cells
LIPF - Chief cells
Pgc, Gif 
Tff1 (stomach surface), Tff2 - pan stomach epithelial cell markers
Tff3 - intestinal (goblet cell) marker
FABP1 - intestinal differentiated cells

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
sel_markers=c("CD44","SOX2","LGR5","MUC6","MUC5AC","GKN1","GKN2","GAST","GHRL","CHGA","PGC","GIF","MUC2", "DCLK1", "TFF1","TFF2","TFF3","FABP1", "LIPF","ATP4A","ATP4B","PGA3" )
```

## Global markers

CD45 is Ptprc.  
Ly6g is transiently expressed in monocytes in BM, while it is increasingly expressed in granulocytes and neutrophils with maturation.  
Pglyrp1 - circulating polymorphonuclear leukocytes (granulocytes + mast cells)  

We here add Cd3e/d/g as pan-T marker and Cd20 (Ms4a1) as mature B-cell marker.
Gata3, Cxcr6, Rora - T-cell markers

Ly6a(Sca-1) - positive in HSC/MPP
Procr,Fdg5, Hoxb5 - HSC

Epor, Slamf1(Cd150) - MegE - lineage

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}

sel_markers=toupper(c("Ptprc","Tcrb","Ly6g","Pglyrp1","Cd4","Cd3e","Cd3d","Cd3g", "Gata3","Cxcr6","Rora","Cd7","Cd8a","Cd19","Ms4a1","Ly6a", "Cd34","Procr","Fgd5","Hoxb5","Epor","Slamf1","Nkg7","Col1a1"))
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

#plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
DotPlot(scData.combined, features = sel_markers, cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA") + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))
```

## Granulocyte subpopulations

Pglyrp1 - circulating polymorphonuclear leukocytes (granulocytes + mast cells)  
Csf3r - colony stimulating factor 3 receptor (granulocytes)  G-CSF-R. Higher in mature blood neutrophils (Shinjo et al. 1995 doi: 10.1111/j.1365-2141.1995.tb05390.x)

Mpo,Elane - neutrophil markers  
Prg2,Prg3 - eosinophils (Dahlin)  
Gzmb, Cma1 - Mast cell (Dahlin)  
Ms4a2, Cpa3 Mast cell, basophil (Dahlin)  
Prss34, Mcpt8 - basophil (Dahlin)  
Cd200r3 is a receptor on mastcells on basophils.  
Fcer1a - basophils, mastcells - high affinity IgE receptor  
Ggnt2, Ear2, Siglecf - eosinophils  
Il5ra - eosinophil progenitor  
Chil3 - immature neutrophils (Nio et al 2004  doi: 10.1007/s00418-004-0654-4)  


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}

sel_markers=toupper(c("Pglyrp1","Csf3r","Mpo","Elane","Chil3","Cd200r3","Gngt2","Ear2","Il5ra","Siglecf","Prg2","Prg3","Gzmb","Cma1","Ms4a2","Cpa3","Prss34","Mcpt8","Fcer1a"))
DefaultAssay(scData.combined) <- "RNA"

#plot_genes(scData.combined, sel_markers)
DotPlot(scData.combined, features = sel_markers, cols="RdYlBu", assay="RNA")
```

# Apoptosis score and mitochondrial RNA

We use the HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS gene set from MSigDB to compute an apoptosis score as the mean expression across all signature genes per cell. 

```{r}
library(fgsea)

gset_collections_human = list()

gsea_gmt_folder = "../../../../Data/ExtData/genesets/MSigDB/msigdb_v2023.2.Hs_GMTs"
gsea_gmt_files = c("h.all.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt") 
names(gsea_gmt_files) = c("HALLMARK")
gset_collections_human = list()

for (n in names(gsea_gmt_files)) {
  gset_collections_human[[n]] = gmtPathways(paste(gsea_gmt_folder, gsea_gmt_files[[n]], sep="/") )
}
```

```{r}
apoptosis_sig_genes_hs = gset_collections_human[[1]][["HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS"]]
```

```{r}
sel_mat = Assays(subset(scData.combined, features=apoptosis_sig_genes_hs), "RNA")@data

scData.combined = AddMetaData(scData.combined, col.name = "apoptosis_score", apply(sel_mat, 2, mean, na.rm=T) )
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(object = scData.combined,  features = "percent_mito", reduction="umap", label=T)
```

```{r, fig.height=8}
tmp = data.frame(percent_mito = scData.combined$percent_mito, batch= scData.combined$batch, group_label = scData.combined$batch )
ggplot(tmp, aes(fill=batch, x=group_label, y = percent_mito)) + geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(object = scData.combined,  features = "apoptosis_score", reduction="umap", label=T)
```

```{r, fig.height=8}
tmp = data.frame(apoptosis_score = scData.combined$apoptosis_score, batch= scData.combined$batch, group_label = scData.combined$batch )
ggplot(tmp, aes(fill=batch, x=group_label, y = apoptosis_score)) + geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

```

# Final cluster assigment

```{r}
cluster_assignment = read.table(file.path(data_storage_folder, "Cluster_assignments/Cluster_assignments_2024-02-22.txt"), sep="\t",header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
options(width = 180)
print(cluster_assignment)
rownames(cluster_assignment) = as.character(cluster_assignment$ClusterID)
scData.combined = AddMetaData(scData.combined, cluster_assignment[as.character(scData.combined$seurat_clusters),"Label"], col.name = "cluster_label")
scData.combined = AddMetaData(scData.combined, cluster_assignment[as.character(scData.combined$seurat_clusters),"Type"], col.name = "cluster_type")
```

